title: India's electronics production grew 7x in a decade
sources: Business Standard, 29 Jul 2026 - India's electronics production up around 16% in FY26
India Tribune, 2026 - India's electronics production grows seven-fold in a decade, creates 25 lakh jobs: MeitY
caption:
In 2014, India barely made its own electronics. Today, it's building one of the fastest-growing electronics industries on Earth.

India's electronics production hit Rs 13.11 lakh crore in FY26, up nearly sevenfold from Rs 1.90 lakh crore in 2014-15. Mobile phone manufacturing alone grew 33x, from Rs 18,900 crore to Rs 6.27 lakh crore.

Electronics exports grew even faster - up 11x, making it India's third-largest export category. The country now has over 300 mobile manufacturing units, compared to just two in 2014.

This growth created roughly 25 lakh jobs, most of them in factories that didn't exist a decade ago.

This isn't just about phones. It's a supply chain India had to build from nothing, one factory at a time.

Sources: PIB/MeitY, Business Standard, India Tribune (2026)
